user.title: Connect an Aduro stove
user.description: The stove must be reachable from Home Assistant over the local network. Stop the legacy Aduro2MQTT add-on before continuing because both use UDP port 1901.

data_description.name: Name shown for the device in Home Assistant.
data_description.host: Local IP address or resolvable host name of the stove.
data_description.serial: Controller serial number used by the Aduro app.
data_description.pin: Controller PIN used by the Aduro app.

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the stove.
error.invalid_auth: The stove rejected the serial number or PIN.
error.unknown: Unexpected error. Check the Home Assistant log.
